title: Event log card with chronological entries, clear confirmation, and export
description: Implement web/src/components/EventLogPanel.jsx rendering a scrollable list of timestamped system events with severity icons, a Clear Log button with confirmation dialog, and an Export Log button (JSON/CSV).
acceptanceCriteria: Displays chronological list of events with timestamps, event types, and readable descriptions (PRD 6.8)
Uses small status icons (info, alert, fault) alongside text
List scrolls independently with a max height without stretching page height
Clear Log triggers confirmation prompt before deleting records
Export Log downloads logs as CSV or JSON file

steps.details: Create web/src/components/EventLogPanel.jsx fetching events from GET /api/logs on mount and interval/stream update.
Trigger window.confirm or modal dialog on Clear Log, then send DELETE /api/logs; create anchor download link for GET /api/logs/export.
Style event table/list with monospace timestamp, small colored badges, scroll container with custom scrollbar, and clean action buttons.
Run Playwright test verifying log items render and clicking export works; take screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-29-1.png.

technicalNotes: Avoid storing raw video or biometric images in logs to adhere to PRD FR-10.
Handle empty log state with clean empty message.
